arguments.text: 8 km, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Calibration: boat CP 107 W / 11.4 kJ, pod CP 162 W / 19.2 kJ (may be 10-25 pct off). Target: settle after the start to about pod 165-170 W (boat ~110 W), even effort, keep pod reserve above ~30 pct until 2 km to go, then spend it: push at 1500 m to go, finish sprint at ~400 m to go. Watch for incidents: sudden drop in push_local (weed on rudder / drag) -> consider clear_rudder; pod vs boat power diverging (pod drift); radio course change -> set_race_distance and tell. Compare same-direction legs for current.

arguments.message: GPS speed well below what pod power should give: weed on rudder, wind, or pod drift? Check power_w vs shaft_power_w and rate.
Pod reserve below 25 pct with more than 2.5 km left: ease to CP.

arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, long smooth strokes, race rhythm.

1.2 min: start hard, pod 216 W vs CP 162, rate 71, reserve pod 83 pct. Cued ease to 162 s/500 over ground. Watches: drag_jump (push_local - push_along < -0.3 for 20 s), pod_reserve_low. Check at ~3 min that pod power settled to ~165-170 W.

arguments.reason: check the paddler settled after the start cue

text: Cued ease to 162 s/500 after a hard start (pod 216 W vs CP 162); set plan, two watches, wake in 90 s.

arguments.text: Ease a little more. Even pace now, save it for later.

arguments.reason: check pod power settled near 165-170 W after second ease cue

text: Cued ease to 161 s/500: pod 182 W still above sustainable 167 W, pod reserve 63 pct at 2.7 min.

arguments.text: 4.8 min, 935 m: settled. Pod 168 W (sustainable 166), rate 64, pod reserve 56 pct, boat reserve 50 pct. Leg 1 north GPS ~3.15-3.2 m/s with push_local ~+0.13. Boat/pod power ratio ~0.66. No cue needed while pod stays 163-172 W.

text: no cue: paddler settled at pod 168 W, right on sustainable power.

arguments.text: You are fine, reserve is good. Ease slightly, steady effort.

6.7 min, 1271 m, leg 2 south (push_along -0.05, against). Paddler: I am cooked, effort 7/10, really hurting. Instruments: pod 180 W vs sustainable 166, pod reserve 50 pct, boat reserve 40 pct, no fade (+1.2 pct). Likely chasing my 161 over-ground pace into the current. Cued ease slightly, no pace target. Lesson: avoid over-ground pace targets, current flips each leg; cue by effort.

arguments.reason: check paddler response to ease cue after saying cooked

text: Cued reassurance with ease slightly: paddler says cooked (7/10) but pod reserve 50 pct and no fade; pod 180 W above sustainable 166.
